summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. Changes: rdflib/namespace.py adds Namespace.__contains__ (prefix membership via str(ref).startswith(str(self))) and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ (returns True only if str(ref) equals a stored term URI; _RDFNamespace inherits it). test/test_namespace.py gains tests for SH/custom Namespace prefix membership, RDFS closed membership (label True, example False), and RDF closed membership (type True, _1 False). Not run: per instructions, no tests, doctests, or repository code were executed, and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only.
